integrity: Direct Hamiltonian enumeration and independent cyclic-rank census were carried out using the included reproducibility script.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite-size covariance is for rings with at least eleven bonds and iid atomless positive couplings; the CLT is in the thermodynamic limit. Counts of stable states do not determine dynamical attraction probabilities. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Negative covariance across two levels of metastability in a random-bond Ising ring
